# Force Productions

> Stories that Spark Conversation.

Force Productions is a video production company based in Cambridge, Ontario,
Canada, serving the Cambridge, Kitchener and Waterloo region. It is led by
founder, director and producer Andy Hourahine, who was awarded the Queen's
Diamond Jubilee Medal for his outstanding contributions to the community.

Contact: andy@forceproductions.ca
Website: https://forceproductions.ca
Portfolio: https://vimeopro.com/user3208094/force-productions

## Mission

Force Productions' mission is to help create visual stories that spark
conversation and initiate positive change. Our cameras go to the heart of the
narrative and capture rich, clear images and sound that reflect your world.
Whether it is a service that can change lives, a person who makes a difference,
or a company looking to stand out from the crowd and be heard, Force Productions
loves to share stories and ignite inspiration.

## Service area

Cambridge, Kitchener, Waterloo, Waterloo Region, Guelph, Brantford, and
Southern Ontario.

## Services

- Mission Videos — video production highlighting an organization's key mission
  and values, so customers can see it eye-to-eye and start building a positive
  connection.
- Product Videos — customer testimonials, product showcase and executive quotes
  that provide information, answer key questions and build brand liking.
- Video Blogs — ongoing video conversations that generate inbound leads and can
  be repurposed for multi-platform use such as podcasts, text blogs and social
  campaigns.
- Special Projects — custom video work built around an important element or
  event, for use online, in-person or at events.

## Selected clients

Rogers Television, The City of Cambridge, CBC Live Right Now, Grand River Film
Festival, University of Waterloo, YMCA, Osteoporosis Canada, Seishin
International / Karate by Jesse, Next Level Performance Training.
